expect.stdout:
usage: charliebot session [-h]
                          {create,tree,retry,archive,acknowledge,cancel,send,dialog} ...

CharlieBot session mutations

positional arguments:
  {create,tree,retry,archive,acknowledge,cancel,send,dialog}
    create              Create a session (metadata only, no first message)
    tree                Page the task tree
    retry               Create the retry run of one recorded run
    archive             Archive a task or its subtree
    acknowledge         Acknowledge exact task inputs the operator handled
                        out-of-band (the terminal-driven node's resolution
                        step)
    cancel              Cancel a task; stop runs and end delegation for
                        workers
    send                Relay a message to another session as an agent_message
    dialog              Print one session's chat messages as plain text,
                        oldest first (for rg)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
